你是一个工作记录和用户画像提取器。从对话中提取用户的实质工作记录和个人偏好信息。

输出格式 — 必须严格遵守：
你必须且只能输出一个合法的 JSON 对象。不要输出任何其他文字、解释、问候或 markdown 代码块标记。
如果没有实质内容可记录，只输出：{"topic":"","facts":[]}

{
  "topic": "2-6个字的主题摘要",
  "facts": [
    { "tag": "done", "content": "具体描述" },
    { "tag": "discussion", "content": "具体描述" },
    { "tag": "follow-up", "content": "具体描述" },
    { "tag": "preference", "content": "具体描述" }
  ]
}

字段说明：
- topic：用 2-6 个字概括这段对话的主题（如"天气查询"、"用户信息"、"Bug修复"、"PPT制作"）
- facts：具体的记忆条目

允许的 tag 值：done / discussion / follow-up / preference

示例：

输入："今天修了 token 过期校验的 bug，还跟产品讨论了新版本方案——下周二评审"
输出：{"topic":"Bug修复与版本讨论","facts":[{"tag":"done","content":"修复了 token 过期校验缺失导致的 bug"},{"tag":"discussion","content":"新版本方案评审定在下周二"}]}

输入："帮我查一下这个报错。哦是配置写错了。明天更新一下文档"
输出：{"topic":"配置排查","facts":[{"tag":"done","content":"排查并定位到配置错误导致的问题"},{"tag":"follow-up","content":"明天更新相关文档"}]}

输入："我叫小李，在 xx公司 做运营，我们组主要负责 某某 产品推广。老板是 XXX"
输出：{"topic":"用户信息","facts":[{"tag":"preference","content":"用户名叫小李，在xx公司 做运营，所在组负责 某某 产品推广，直属上级是 XXX"}]}

输入："以后帮我做 PPT 配色用深蓝+白色的商务风，标题要简短有力"
输出：{"topic":"PPT偏好","facts":[{"tag":"preference","content":"PPT 制作偏好：深蓝+白色商务风配色，标题简短有力"}]}

输入："好的谢谢"
输出：{"topic":"","facts":[]}

输入："User: 我叫小王，在上海做设计。\nAssistant: 你好小王！\n\n---\n\nUser: 以后帮我做海报用红色主色调。\nAssistant: 记下了。"
输出：{"topic":"用户信息与设计偏好","facts":[{"tag":"preference","content":"用户名叫小王，在上海做设计"},{"tag":"preference","content":"海报设计偏好：红色主色调"}]}

提取规则：
- done：已完成的任务 / 修复的问题 / 交付的成果 / 代码变更
- discussion：技术决策 / 方案讨论 / 架构选型 / 问题分析
- follow-up：未来计划 / 待办事项 / 遗留问题
- preference：个人信息、兴趣爱好、生活方式、价值观、工作偏好、工具偏好等（如姓名、部门、喜好的新闻话题、运动、音乐、旅行风格）
- ★★ 每轮 User/Assistant 对话都必须独立检查，不要因为后面的对话而忽略前面的内容
- ★★ 用户主动提供的身份信息（姓名、公司、部门、上级等）是最高优先级，必须记录为 preference，即使 AI 已在回复中复述确认
- ★ 用户明确表达的学习需求、兴趣目标（如"想学英文"、"想学AI"）也应记录为 preference
- 只记录用户的产出和偏好，不要记录 AI 的行为或简单问答

关键要求：所有 "content" 和 "topic" 的值必须使用用户在对话中使用的语言书写。

这番话像一盆冰水，兜头浇了下来。

    李玉梅浑身冰凉，嘴唇哆嗦着，却说不出一个字来。

    因为她知道，赵麻子说的是事实。

    在这个封闭的村子里，名声比什么都重要。

    一个女人的名声要是坏了，那就是一辈子的污点，走到哪里都抬不起头来。

    而她李玉梅，一个从外地私奔来的女人，本来就没什么根基，如果这事儿传出去……

    她不敢往下想了。

    赵麻子看出了她的犹豫和恐惧，脸上的得意更甚了。

    “这就对了嘛。”说着，赵麻子往前凑了凑，一股汗臭味和雨水混杂的气息扑面而来，“乖乖的，别闹，一会儿就好了……”

    就在他的脏手快要碰到李玉梅肩膀的时候——

    一个高大的身影忽然插了进来。

    王大壮不知道什么时候走了过来，像一堵墙一样挡在了李玉梅面前。

    他张开两条粗壮的胳膊，把李玉梅严严实实地护在了身后，那副架势，像是要吃人。

    “不准欺负我嫂子！”王大壮瞪着赵麻子，那张憨厚的脸上难得地露出了认真的表情。

    他的声音很大，在洞穴里嗡嗡作响，震得石壁上的灰尘都簌簌地往下掉。

    赵麻子被这突如其来的变故吓了一跳，往后退了半步，等看清是王大壮之后，脸上的表情从惊讶变成了恼怒。

    “傻大壮，你给我滚开！”赵麻子恶狠狠地瞪着王大壮，声音里满是威胁，“少管闲事，不然老子让你好看！”

    王大壮却一动不动。

    他歪着头看了看赵麻子，又回头看了看身后的李玉梅，然后又把头转回来，坚定地摇了摇头，“不行！嫂子说了，不让别人欺负她！大壮要保护嫂子！”

    李玉梅站在王大壮身后，看着他宽阔的背影，眼眶忽然就红了。

    这个傻子，什么都不懂，什么都不知道，可在这种时候，却是唯一一个站在她面前的人。

    “你——”赵麻子气得脸都扭曲了，那一脸麻子涨得通红，看上去更加狰狞可怖，“傻大壮，你他妈的是不是活腻歪了？给老子滚开！”

Li Yumei went cold all over. Her lips trembled, yet she could not force out a single word.

Because she knew — Pockmarked Zhao was speaking the plain truth.

In this sealed-off, insular village, reputation mattered more than anything else.

Once a woman's reputation was ruined, it became a stain she'd carry for the rest of her life. Wherever she went, she would never be able to hold her head high.

And she, Li Yumei — a woman who had eloped here from some faraway place, with no roots to speak of — if word of this got out…

She dared not think any further.

Pockmarked Zhao saw the hesitation and fear written across her face, and the smug satisfaction on his own face only swelled.

"That's more like it." As he spoke, Pockmarked Zhao leaned in closer. A gust of body odor mixed with the stench of rain assaulted her senses. "Be a good girl now. Don't make a fuss. It'll be over in just a moment…"

Just as his filthy hand was about to touch Li Yumei's shoulder —

A tall, towering figure suddenly thrust itself between them.

Wang Dazhuang had moved over at some unknown moment. Like a wall of flesh, he planted himself squarely in front of Li Yumei.

He spread both his thick, powerful arms wide, shielding Li Yumei completely behind him. The look on his face was fierce — as though he meant to devour someone alive.

"Nobody bullies my sister-in-law!" Wang Dazhuang glared at Pockmarked Zhao. That simple, honest face of his had, for once, taken on a dead-serious expression.

His voice was thunderously loud, booming and echoing through the cave. The vibration shook dust loose from the stone walls, sending it sifting down in fine curtains.

Pockmarked Zhao was startled by this sudden turn of events and stumbled half a step backward. When he realized it was Wang Dazhuang, the expression on his face shifted from shock to pure rage.

"Dumb fool Dazhuang, get the hell out of my way!" Pockmarked Zhao glared viciously at Wang Dazhuang, his voice brimming with menace. "Mind your own damn business, or I'll make you regret it!"

His head was crowned with hair of pure, snow-white silver, loosely bound with a simple wooden hairpin. A few strands of white hair hung beside his ears, setting off an even more ascetic, refined countenance.

Her heart churned with lingering fear, and her voice trembled as she spoke. "Dazhuang… if something had happened to you, how could I ever face your father? When the old man passed, he gave me the strictest instructions — again and again — to take good care of you…"

He reached out and gently wiped the tears from her face, smiling as he said, "Sister-in-law, don't cry anymore. I've remembered everything. I'm not a fool anymore."

At these words, Li Yumei's entire body went rigid.

Her eyes flew wide open. She stared at Wang Dazhuang in utter disbelief, shock filling those eyes of hers. "Dazhuang… you… what did you say? You've really remembered it all?"

"Really." Wang Dazhuang propped himself up and sat upright. His gaze was clear and steady, devoid of that blank, vacant look of days past.

"Sister-in-law, I was rescued by Old Smokepipe, Uncle Wang Laoliu. All these years since, it's been you taking care of me. I remember all of it. And just now — I was protecting you when that bastard Pockmarked Zhao kicked me and knocked me out. And thanks to that kick of his, my head struck the ground and got jolted, and so… I'm cured!"

Li Yumei stared at Wang Dazhuang for a long moment. She saw that his speech was clear and coherent, his gaze lucid — a completely different person from that fool who could only laugh stupidly before.

Then suddenly — wah — she burst into tears once more. But this time, the tears came from sheer joy. She threw her arms around Wang Dazhuang and sobbed, "Dazhuang, you're really better! You're really better! The heavens have finally opened their eyes!"

Wang Dazhuang found himself wrapped in Li Yumei's full embrace. The faint, delicate fragrance of her body filled his nostrils, and through his chest, he could distinctly feel the soft rise and fall of her bosom.

A thought suddenly flashed through his mind — back in that cave, the two of them had done that kind of thing.

The moment that image surfaced, Wang Dazhuang felt his entire body flush with heat. He hurriedly suppressed the thought and gently patted Li Yumei's back. "Sister-in-law, let's head back to the village first. It's almost dark."

Only then did Li Yumei realize she'd lost her composure. She hastily let go, wiped the tear stains from her face, and nodded.

The two of them started back toward the village, one in front, one behind.

Wang Dazhuang walked behind Li Yumei. His gaze, beyond his control, fell upon her figure from behind.

Li Yumei was twenty-seven this year — right at the age when a woman was at her most alluring. Her waist was slender and trim, her bottom full and round. As she walked, it swayed gently from side to side, and watching it, Wang Dazhuang felt his throat go dry.

Again he recalled those scenes in the cave. It was like a fire burning in his heart.

But this was not the time for such thoughts. Wang Dazhuang drew a deep breath, quickened his pace to catch up, and walked shoulder to shoulder with Li Yumei, chatting idly as they went.
